scope: One future RK03 transition-only probe after offline qualification and explicit human authorization
voltage_policy: Operator monitors battery power; no numerical battery readings requested. G18 retains the established measured vehicle-side complete-power-loss requirement.

operator_context.source: Latest user directive; confirm actual Test Mode observations at G09
operator_context.charger: Schumacher SE-5212A, 10 A charging only; never 50 A Engine Start

pre_probe_gates.action: With ignition OFF, connect the two Subaru green Test Mode connectors.
Turn ignition ON. Keep engine OFF.
Observe and report actual Test Mode indications. Intentionally disconnected fans are not expected to cycle.

display: provider SHA256 and expected API version
BF81/83-only transmit whitelist and no seed/key/upload
charger state and operator voltage monitoring
current process/module scan for ECUFlash/RomRaider/other J2534 clients
probe invocation count zero; no full acquisition permitted
commit_gate.statement: RK03 TRANSITION PROBE IS NEXT. NO PHYSICAL STATE CHANGES UNTIL IT EXITS.

automatic_after_commit: Recheck pinned inputs and client absence
Record exit and its StopMsgFilter/Disconnect/Close results
Preserve and hash complete evidence; no retry

recovery_gates.action: Physically disconnect OpenPort from the vehicle.
Disconnect/remove the Schumacher charger from the vehicle.
Disconnect battery NEGATIVE terminal and physically isolate it.
Disconnect battery POSITIVE terminal; negative must already be isolated.
Measure the previously verified vehicle-side always-hot supply relative to chassis ground; report actual voltage. Do not infer power loss from elapsed time.
While the vehicle is fully unpowered, disconnect the green Test Mode connectors.
Reconnect/configure Schumacher in 10 A charging mode only.
With ignition OFF and green connectors disconnected, reconnect genuine OpenPort.
Turn ignition ON, engine OFF; green connectors remain disconnected.

automatic_after_recovery_G24.tool: Previously qualified corrected passive BF/A8 observer, unchanged hashes

final_gates_after_successful_oem_return.action: Disconnect charger/support; physical session is complete.

after_G28: Declare PHYSICAL SESSION COMPLETE, then continue only the applicable offline decision branch. Do not run full RK03 acquisition.
terminal_failure_policy: No retry or speculative configuration/timeout change; preserve evidence and finish human recovery before any subsequent offline work
